journey.title: Tab out of the visit date into the access notes
journey.goal: Pressing Tab in the open date field moves focus to the next form field so the user can keep typing

functionalJourney.title: Pick a visit date with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the visit date field

guards.title: Pick the next day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys move the calendar focus and Enter commits the date

plan.root_cause: The datepicker widget steals focus when opened and traps Tab navigation inside its popup, preventing focus from moving to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: After showing the datepicker, explicitly return focus to the associated input element so that subsequent Tab presses move to the next field.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will move focus from the visit date input to the access notes input when the datepicker is open, allowing keyboard users to continue filling the form.
functional_risks: Potentially interfering with datepicker keyboard navigation if the input loses focus while the popup is open; however the datepicker still receives keystrokes via its listener on the input element, so date picking functionality should remain unchanged.
verification_requirements: Tab from #visit-date moves focus to #notes when datepicker is open
Datepicker still responds to ArrowRight/Enter to select a date
Closing datepicker with Escape returns focus to input

plan.root_cause: The datepicker's show() method opens the picker popup but does not guarantee the associated input retains focus after the picker is rendered. When the picker opens, browser focus can shift to the body, causing subsequent Tab key presses to start from body instead of the visit-date input, breaking keyboard navigation to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: After showing the picker, schedule a microtask (via requestAnimationFrame) to explicitly return focus to the input element. This ensures the input remains the active element once the picker's DOM changes have settled, allowing Tab to move to the next form field (notes).
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will move focus from the visit date input to the access notes input when the datepicker is open, allowing keyboard users to continue filling the form without being trapped in the datepicker popup.
functional_risks: Minimal risk of focus flicker if the input already has focus; requestAnimationFrame defers until after browser paint.
Datepicker keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Escape) remains unchanged because the keydown listener stays on the input.
verification_requirements: Tab from #visit-date moves focus to #notes when datepicker is open
Datepicker still responds to ArrowRight/Enter to select a date
Closing datepicker with Escape returns focus to input
